title: A Kalman filtering framework for virtual sensor–enhanced photoacoustic imaging
authors: Bahareh Khishkhah; Rasoul Sadighi-Bonabi; M. Reza Rahimi Tabar
matched_query: photoacoustic imaging virtual sensor Kalman angular sampling reconstruction

summary_en: Introduces a model-based Kalman filtering framework that estimates statistically consistent virtual photoacoustic measurements between physical detector positions. By exploiting acoustic propagation directionality and temporal signal coherence, it improves reconstruction under incomplete angular sampling and noise without adding detector hardware.

summary_en: Systematically compares DDPM, DDIM and score-based generative reconstruction for full-view and limited-view photoacoustic tomography, including physics-informed measurement-consistency refinement. Score-based models provide the strongest structural fidelity across acquisition settings, while DDIM offers a lower-step alternative.

title: Photoacoustic device fingerprints induce bias in deep learning models
authors: Christoph J. Bender; Marcel Knopp; Niklas Holzwarth; Tom Rix; Jan-Hinrich Nölke; Kris K. Dreher; Yi Li; Julius Kempf; Milenko Caranovic; Fabian Schneider; Melanie Schellenberg; Leonie Boland; Briain Haney; Ferdinand Knieling; Ulrich Rother; Alexander Seitel; Lena Maier-Hein

summary_en: Provides a multicentric analysis showing that nominally identical photoacoustic devices leave identifiable image fingerprints. Deep models can exploit correlations between device instance and health status as shortcuts, producing biased disease predictions and overstated internal performance.
